acceptanceCriteria: Each budget/equivalence test stays under 30 s at load at or above 20 while keeping the fixture sizes the spec row states, for example by sampling or caching the oracle.
The equivalence assertion still fails when the batched and per-path results differ.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1524 (V1-2286, V1-1001). After the hooks moved onto the context and 11 tests run in parallel, the whole package went from 650.5 s to 414.5 s on this host. The per-path equivalence oracle runs about 20 ms of git per path, while a batched run takes about 1 s, so each test still costs about 100 s under load. Expected: the oracle costs about as much as the batched run. Actual: it costs about 100x more.
title: doccorpus budget tests still spend about 100 s each under load on the per-path git oracle (about 20 ms per path)
